findings.description: New pins and archives explicitly bind owner identity; scoped import remaps outer owner only; old provenance remains unknown
Reject malformed Region ancestry and post-normalization pin/archive byte overflow without pruning
Refuse flat and nested Pinned Detach with ambiguous clipping, frame background/opacity or child shadows before mutation
Central style deletion now includes editor history, drafts and same-workspace clipboard; clipboard asset refs also protected
Portable import/export checks source-owned style and asset closure, duplicate private/public IDs, templates and archive-only dependencies before remapping
Malformed Tile dependencies block asset removal; strict cells/stash structure required by dependency collector
Page-only persistence rejects stored/queued common revision or archive mismatch and newly missing style references instead of silently using stale definitions
Nested pinned detach with remapped outer identity is refused rather than guessing live child identity in destination
Startup and full restore share workspace validation; inactive scope checked; reject nested registry and malformed Tile without overwriting stored payload; validate draft ownership before restore

Restore checks owner and revision after asynchronous guard, blocks concurrent editing, requires prior backup, reports CAS conflict and distinguishes post-commit UI failure; raw recovery preserves previous payload and exposes invalid backups as raw exports

Q-005 public images hidden, never removed by library reset; only unreferenced active private resources removed; mixed delete stops on failed public mutation; private delete/undo blocked during uncertain persistence
A13 expected-side history snapshots and editor/clipboard references protected; component delete checks draft identity and live edges without conflating closed snapshot IDs
Valid common archive records retain additive metadata during normalization; no fabricated legacy provenance
Distinguish missing key, empty/non-text payload and nonzero-revision missing data at startup; never initialize over invalid persisted data
Expose direct raw textual export without portable JSON cap; raw-only checkpoint flag, preserve empty textual payload, refuse non-text replacement; cancel conflict reload on draft export failure
Clear catalog draft, clipboard and page session on full editor reset, including restore to identical workspace IDs
Require explicit full save for legacy workspace without persisted owner ID; compare normalized common definition bodies and archives on page-only persistence rather than raw serialization
Do not roll back image reset in memory after confirmed persistence when UI refresh fails; distinguish committed restore with failed UI and block restored draft opening
Page-only save requires full save if normalized active portfolio differs from persisted alias; retry refuses repeating known full-save-required failures and rechecks owner

Backup browsing and raw download remain read-only despite save errors; valid and raw textual backups offer raw export; raw-only cannot restore; named backup requires settled persistence and reports CAS conflict
Recovery confirmation and replacement use the same normalized candidate; post-commit reload failure distinguished from rejected replacement
Library reset rolls back only before enqueue; after uncertain async flush retain proposed memory state rather than speculatively reverting a committed snapshot
A13 discard requires exact active portfolio/page-array scope before and after asynchronous continuation checks

Dedicated per-operation in-memory write receipt; distinguish COMMITTED, REJECTED, NOT_QUEUED, UNKNOWN; rendering/status errors cannot misclassify a committed IndexedDB write; acknowledgement failure blocks recovery

v77Persist checks unsettled storage and owner; rollback only before enqueue or confirmed rejection with unchanged exact snapshot and no successor; otherwise retain candidate and block uncertain writes

Project-file and journal-backed ZIP open consume operation receipt; confirmed commit separated from UI error, rollback only on attributable rejection; journal reconciliation remains authoritative for disk files
Scoped portfolio import freezes owner and destination reference from picker through confirmation, preserves pre-existing private asset and common definition records, appends only validated additions

Independent project import remaps source-private IDs colliding with public destination catalog and remaps album membership; refuse missing template category and ambiguous historical template identity instead of destination fallback
Receipt rechecks exact candidate, owner, queue revision and pending state at undo time; storage flags precede DOM status; rejected root replacement blocks stale scope retry.
Project switch/create/rename/legacy deletion and portfolio activation consume attributable receipts; committed UI failure never restores previous state.
Managed project registry deletion consumes operation receipt for active/inactive and disk-backed paths; workspace, record and revision checked during disk preparation.
Journal requires exact base revision for rejection or base+1 with matching receipt for commit; rereads before disk mutation and journal removal; ambiguous successor retains recovery evidence.
Style save, public image rename, template/page creation, album mutations and image reset consume per-write receipts.
NSP Data Controls and component definition writes consume attributable receipts; import rechecks original owner snapshot and blocks rejected root-scope retry.

Page save now requires the exact live page object and returns an operation receipt; explicit navigation validates receipt, scope and page stamp. Global flush rejects successor, pending or recovery state.
Both template application paths use page receipts and freeze chooser owner/page identity; no rollback on committed UI failure.
Discard, page ordering and cut/paste structure use attributable receipts; prior state retained only for exact rollback eligibility.

Ordinary IndexedDB writes share the same-origin Journal lock; exclusive disk transaction validates its receipt ID and base revision, and registry-only delete carries a non-persisted token. Pending Journal blocks other writes.
Disk preparation rechecks revision before Journal and file mutation; newly appeared nonempty file refuses overwrite; recovery evidence includes operation ID and base revision.
Restore rechecks full owner snapshot across asynchronous guard, navigation failure after import is distinguished from transaction failure, recovery state survives pending/error indicators.

Dot V330 actual browser measurement: 24 vertical overflows in default Hotel View/Grid; Tehran city 19/23 and 10/13 px, hotel name 65/90 and 30/42 px. V331 computes line-height-aware font ceiling and measures bound card text in the final projected slot via existing text renderer; bounded cache; no text truncation, no preflight suppression.

Grid default rows reserve more vertical capacity and clamp requested spacing within remaining card height. All bound visible card labels fit against final slot dimensions, including edited Component Editor definitions; preserve hidden/static authored elements and underlying data. At minimum 6 px, an unfittable field remains a print-blocking diagnostic.

Dot reproduced a long Hotel Text record wrapping into two lines: fixed frame 29 px vs actual 58 px, blocking print in V330 and V331. V332 measures natural wrapped height using the existing text renderer at selected font size, advances subsequent rows by measured height, preserves full underlying text and unchanged print-blocking diagnostics.

Measure custom Hotel Text at its final scaled slot width and typography including borders and effects, without measuring the discarded default layout. Bounded separate 1024-entry height cache invalidated on font loading events. Inline mode verifies total capacity; insufficient or unmeasurable height fails closed. V331 Hotel View/Grid fitting algorithm not changed.

Confirmed in V332 index.html lines 17859,17902,17916,17927,17997–18001: renderScene passed renderer tools as the third argument to layoutText, whose new third argument means slotEffects. Spread order in text() then allowed tools.text (a function) to overwrite the bound string. V333 explicitly separates text/card dispatch, filters visual overrides to an allowlist, and assigns the bound text after overrides.

Confirmed in V332 index.html lines 18562–18564,18625–18635: the nsp-slots IIFE declared N but not V, then used V.graphicsCore.scene.shouldPaint(s) for Hotel Text custom slots. V333 explicitly binds V=V13 and N=V.nsp in that IIFE. No change to slot geometry, visibility contract or prior card fit algorithm.

Source-confirmed V333 index.html: v20VisualFields validates Tile dimensions, cells, stash coordinates and member types, but v111AssetIds only checks array/object containers; valid JSON containing a number/boolean/array as a cell, invalid stash coordinate or invalid assetId can pass dependency collection. M.references skips non-text tilesJson. Single/bulk removal and library Undo use M.references; reset and portable/page dependency checks use v111AssetIds. V334 shares the existing normalization validator and routes nonempty non-text metadata to fail-closed handling. Existing validated startup rejects many such inputs; runtime reachability/data loss not established. No raw data rewrite or schema change.

V334 index.html L4509-L4526, L4556-L4557: private image changes and library Undo/Redo use save(true), which at L10957 only enqueues a workspace snapshot. History is advanced before COMMITTED; importFiles catch unconditionally restores the old library even if render throws after enqueue. registerDecoded returns an asset ID before persistence. V335 routes these private mutations through v329PersistChange and moves library history/UI only after their own receipt; import and image bind recheck owner and candidate, and mixed delete/import callers await success. Runtime reachability/data loss not established.

V334 index.html L7894-L7930: gePageTxn and geApplyPageTxn use save(true) and immediately advance structural history, independent of the result of the corresponding transaction. V335 uses v329PersistChange and exact owner/page-array/history checks before moving history, awaits structural transactions at all four callsites and preserves Clipboard publication guards. Ordinary single-page optimistic editor behavior is not changed. Runtime acceptance pending.

Source-confirmed in V335 index.html L11373-L11404: restore enqueued pre-restore save and set ready=false before DOM preparation outside try/finally; a preparation exception stranded the adapter. Its unguarded finally status() could throw after COMMITTED, or render catch could mask the original receipt; successful return with failed UI was also possible. L11444 opened restored draft outside the committed-result distinction. V336 prepares blocking UI inside try before enqueue, tracks cleanup independently, reports committed vs unconfirmed replacement and blocks uncertain UI continuation; restored draft opening failure is explicitly post-commit.

Source-confirmed in V335 index.html L11540-L11566: editor reset, route/dashboard rendering and status() shared outer catch with IndexedDB read and validation. A display failure after successful data validation invoked corrupt-storage recovery and offered destructive replacement. V336 separates read/validation from UI initialization; UI-only failure blocks writes and offers read-only RAW export/reload, not replacement. Fresh initialization follows successful UI setup. No change to CAS, backup format or schema.

V336 index.html L5059–5080: public image/logo import admits a workspace write through save() but treats it as completed; preparation or post-enqueue render failure unconditionally replaces the catalog with an earlier copy, potentially undoing newer in-memory edits or diverging from a committed IndexedDB snapshot. Folder import callers at L14000 and L14275 ignore the operation result. V337 stages assets without catalog mutation, checks exact owner/catalog identity and contents before commit, avoids in-place unarchive, uses per-operation receipt and only attributable rollback, separates post-commit UI failure and gates both folder callers on success. Source-confirmed defect; runtime reachability and actual data loss not established.

V337 L14294–14309, L14408–14451, L14120–14151: active unified picker exposes private and public originals; choosing a private asset in a global template permanently publishes without explicit grant and binds after queue admission, not a durable receipt. This contradicts the one-way publication policy at L4704–4715. V338 obtains explicit grant for a new public original, preserves the private original, avoids relying on imported hash equality, allocates a noncolliding ID, persists via attributable receipt, and rechecks original root, exact draft/stamp, selection/Tile and picker lifetime before binding. All picker consumers await the result; actual add result is returned. Cancellation after commit does not unpublish. Runtime acceptance pending.

V337 L867–896 permits duplicate album IDs across separate public/private namespaces, while L14114–14118 and L14138–14162 flatten them into unscoped UI IDs; L14238–14293 resolves mutations and asynchronous folder upload by that ambiguous ID. A valid public/private same-ID pair can resolve a private selection to the public album, mix subtree membership, or modify the wrong folder. V338 projects scoped UI keys and scoped parents, retains raw persisted IDs, uses raw records for writes, captures upload owner/record, and refuses stale popup/upload ownership. No migration or automatic modification of stored album IDs. Runtime acceptance pending.

V338 L835, L858–862 validate image source syntax but do not verify imported hash metadata. L4623, L4656–4658, L4709, L4729, L4740, L5074 use hash equality OR actual source equality, and L14136–14145 hides distinct images with equal metadata. A valid imported record with a reused/stale hash and different source can suppress import, publication or sharing, or select a wrong original for replacement. L2735 accepts a public dependency without source by matching unverified hash, bypassing the missing-original rejection. V339 requires exact source equality for these comparisons and rejects missing public originals before deduplication; no existing source, hash or ID is rewritten. Different textual encodings may remain separate intentionally. Runtime not run.

V338 L4705–4746 explicit ownership paths allocate IDs without checking all applicable namespaces, copy archived visibility to newly granted resources, and render outside the post-commit outcome guard; L5076 allocates public upload IDs before asynchronous preparation completes and checks only active private IDs. A copied archived public original can become an invisible private grant; public collisions with an inactive private original violate L859 and inactive restore normalization L11352. V339 aligns explicit paths with permanent source ownership, exact receipts and post-commit handling, makes new grants visible, validates destination record, and allocates global IDs across active/inactive/staged source namespaces in public upload, explicit publication and portable dependency import. Auto-publication V338 already guards these namespaces and is unchanged. Runtime reachability of ID collision not established.

V339 L1034–1048 legacy v112 album write uses save()/global flush and unconditionally restores old album state on any failure, including render after commit. L1071–1079 removes parents without guarding children, causing persisted invalid hierarchy on reload. V340 uses attributable workspace receipt, distinct post-commit UI handling, valid scope and child guard. Older v112 view superseded by active V222; actual legacy UI reachability not established.

V339 L8931–8959 page duplicate/delete enqueue saveProject then unconditionally undo on false global flush; committed operation with later unrelated failure can diverge from IndexedDB. Portfolio deletion L2411–2420 resets all editor state without draft guard. V340 prechecks mutation status, uses exact receipts and guarded post-commit UI; protects unresolved continuation markers and open catalog drafts. No schema change.

V339 L14880–14910 cut commits deletion before volatile v235PageClipboard publication, so close/reload/failed paste loses the only live page; clipboard compares only workspace ID and is missing from dependency references L9115–9119 and resetAll L9161. V340 changes cut to deferred intent: preserve source until atomic move/paste, guard exact root, source record/content, destination and locks/flow; include page clipboard in dependency closure, clear on full context reset, reject stale menu owner. Cut now leaves source visible until successful paste; existing clone ID behavior and cross-portfolio data guard preserved. Actual runtime not run.

V340 L13822–13834, L13900–13927, L14030–14044: retained legacy V220 flattens separate public/private album IDs and parent edges; mutations can resolve wrong scope; async upload re-resolves destination after import/flush. V341 projects scoped UI keys/parents, writes raw IDs within exact store, checks new IDs, resets selection on exact root change and captures/revalidates destination record and added assets across awaits. Active V222 supersedes legacy view; legacy runtime reachability unverified. Existing import privacy policy unchanged.

V340 L10326–10339 and L11099: print settings mutate and render on queue admission, not committed receipt; immediate false result unconditionally rolls back. V341 guards mutation/print state, uses attributable receipt and exact rollback eligibility, and separates post-commit UI. No print policy/schema change. Runtime not run.

V341 L883–892 requires parent and child to have the same effective catalogKind; active V222 L14154–14157 exposes hotel-logo albums but L14285–14288 creates children without the parent's kind, violating the validator for a valid legacy hotel-logo parent. V342 inherits the parent catalogKind when present, preserving ordinary image and root folder defaults and existing records. V220 already carries the kind. Runtime not run.

V341 L7374–7408 stores delayed thumbnail click by bare page ID and keyboard navigation re-resolves ID after await; L7410–7430 drag/drop holds only a local ID. A same-ID page in another portfolio/project or replaced page array can receive stale navigation, template-chooser or reorder requests. V342 captures exact workspace object, portfolio ID, page array, target page object and editor epoch; rechecks before and after save and at drag/drop, rejects stale double click; move uses common mutation admission. Runtime reachability not established.

V341 L8932–8939 sidebar Duplicate calls v100CloneScene directly, which L2308–2315 strips generated continuation metadata; V235 page copy/cut L14893–14896 explicitly rejects unresolved continuation or source links. V342 applies same guard to direct duplicate, including marker-only legacy continuation; ordinary duplication unchanged. No automatic repair/removal of existing relations. Runtime not run.

V341 L8020–8042 gePageTxn consumes operation receipt and advances history only after COMMITTED, but Auto Layout overflow L6810–6823 and Text Flow detach/reflow L15344–15348 and L15540–15548 then call global flush and report original operation unconfirmed if that later flush fails; render exceptions escape committed-result distinction. V342 removes redundant post-receipt global flush in these consumers, keeps pre-operation guards, routes post-commit UI through v329AfterCommit and verifies exact portfolio/page-array. Existing geometry, text, structural history and print policy unchanged. Runtime not run.

V342 index.html L2052, 2086, 2118, 3048, 16398. فهرست پروژه، اسم «بدون پروژه» و تهی بودن سه آرایه را نشانهٔ میزبان داخلی می‌گرفت. یک پروژهٔ واقعی هم‌نام می‌توانست از فهرست و از snapshot تعویض پروژه حذف شود. بازکردن JSON/ZIP نیز سازنده و تاریخ پروژهٔ قبلی را هنگام پارک کردن آن کنار می‌گذاشت.

V342 index.html L952, 960, 12062–12075, 12667–12672. ساخت صفحه از Library یا بسته به آرایهٔ ریشه می‌نوشت، حتی وقتی هیچ پورتفولیویی مالک آن نبود. نرمال‌سازی ریشه را از صفحات پورتفولیو می‌ساخت. بسته نیز پیشرفت را با طول آرایهٔ جاری تشخیص می‌داد.

V342 index.html L9178–9185, 14835, 17934, 18000, 18113. نگهبان حذف هتل، لوگو و تعریف، ارجاع موجود فقط در clipboard صفحه یا checkpoint بازگشت را نمی‌دید. کلید متنی سینی داده نیز برای دو جفت شناسهٔ معتبر دارای دونقطه یکسان می‌شد.

V342 index.html L12076–12092, 12127–12145, 12167–12203, 12262. قالب‌سازی metadata جریان را کپی می‌کرد؛ instantiate شناسه‌های عناصر را تعویض می‌کرد و نشانگر ادامه باقی می‌ماند. اعمال قالب می‌توانست نشانگر بدون flowGenerated یا متن کامل جداشدهٔ روی عنصر قالب قبلی را حذف کند.

V342 index.html L7244–7284. Discard بعد از انتظار برای بررسی امضای ادامه‌ها، آرایه و صفحه را با جست‌وجوی تازه و برابری محتوا می‌سنجید. تعویض با کپی هم‌محتوا می‌توانست از نگهبان بگذرد و تاریخچهٔ نشست دیگری پاک شود.

V342 index.html L9317–9331, 12954–12967, 15825–15864. فرمت از منوی صفحه پس از انتظار دوباره با ID باز می‌شد. فرمان‌های منوی شیء و خواندن async متن کلیپ‌بورد می‌توانستند روی انتخاب یا صفحهٔ جدید اجرا شوند.

V342 index.html L13080–13086, 13148–13154, 13169–13190. fragment هویت پورتفولیو یا پروژه را نداشت. تطبیق صرفاً با tab و filter و پذیرش مالک نامعلوم می‌توانست صفحهٔ هم‌شناسهٔ پورتفولیوی دیگری را در بازخوانی باز کند.

V342 index.html L4385–4397, 9388–9392, 9403–9448. renderer تبدیل/شفافیت/برش قاب را به کل تعریف اعمال می‌کرد. Detach نمونهٔ Live تخت می‌توانست قاب را حذف کند و فقط مستطیل فرزندان را تغییر دهد؛ Insert هم پس از رد add مقدار موفق بازمی‌گرداند.
V342 index.html L10562–10580, 10604–10606, 10748–10752. دکمهٔ گزارش چاپ برای پرش به صفحه فقط ID را در صفحات فعال جست‌وجو می‌کرد. مالک و revision تولیدکنندهٔ گزارش در callback کنترل نمی‌شد.
V342 index.html L16406–16438, 16667–16678, 17020–17027. لایهٔ بیرونی ZIP و حذف فایل، پس از خطای رابط و تأیید Journal نتیجهٔ موفق کلی بازمی‌گرداند. در ZIP این مقدار نمایش موفقیت ۷ از ۷ را فعال می‌کرد.

openFindings: Owner runtime, native, PDF, actual IndexedDB and file-system behavior remain unverified.
An old V342 blank host following an independent import can be indistinguishable from a real empty project. Preserve ambiguous roots; never drop one by display name.
Source review is bounded to the identified browser workflows; unexercised event combinations, visual output and root-level external file changes remain runtime risks.
limits: DEC-006 source-only; no application execution, static checker, build, CI/CD or deployment.
No Native or database schema changes.
All 269 owner rows NOT_RUN; no prior runtime PASS transferred.

Full V333 source audit is not exhaustive; reviewed IndexedDB CAS/receipts/restore, page queue, journal, common pin/archive, portable closure, selected Region/clipboard/history, Hotel Text/View/Grid projection. Remaining call paths and Native require separate review.
